hero.description: The first personal finance app built for Egyptian and MENA families. Track spending, manage debts, monitor your Gam3eya, and forecast your cash flow — all in Arabic.

features.title: Built for the way you handle money
features.subtitle: No more forcing your local financial habits into western apps. Masareef is designed specifically for the unique needs of the MENA market.
features.bankImportDesc: Simply upload your bank PDF or CSV. Our system parses Egyptian bank statements perfectly, no manual entry required.
features.aiCategorizeDesc: Powered by LLMs to understand local merchant names in both Arabic and English for precise spending charts.
features.debtsDesc: Manage your ValU, Sympl, and bank loans with automated amortization schedules and payment reminders.
features.gam3eyaDesc: Manage rotating savings clubs with ease. Know when it's your turn and keep everyone accountable in one place.
features.assetsDesc: Track your real estate value, gold prices, and high-interest certificates in real-time.
features.familyDesc: Share household budgets with your partner. Unified tracking for collaborative financial planning.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to clarity
howItWorks.step1Desc: Upload statements or connect securely. We support all major regional institutions.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our AI identifies your spending habits across local grocers, bills, and lifestyle.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get a comprehensive dashboard showing your net worth, debts, and future forecasts.

dashboard.title: Your financial command center
dashboard.subtitle: Everything you need to see at a glance — balances, spending trends, upcoming payments, and savings goals.

cta.quote: Wealth is not about how much you make, but how much you keep.
